code:
import numpy as np, requests, os, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
D='/tmp/acc'; os.makedirs(D,exist_ok=True)

# --- rat Accsl: find the reviewed/longest entry and fetch sequence ---
q='https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene:Accsl+AND+organism_id:10116&fields=accession,id,length,reviewed,protein_name&format=json&size=20'
js=S.get(q,timeout=90).json()
rat=[(e['primaryAccession'],e.get('uniProtkbId'),e['sequence']['length'],e['entryType']) for e in js['results']]
print('rat Accsl entries:',rat)
racc=sorted(rat,key=lambda r:-r[2])[0][0]
def fasta(acc):
    t=S.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta',timeout=90).text
    return ''.join(t.split('\n')[1:])
seqs={'mouse Accsl Q3UX83':fasta('Q3UX83'),f'rat Accsl {racc}':fasta(racc),
      'human ACCSL Q4AC99':fasta('Q4AC99'),'human ACCS Q96QU6':fasta('Q96QU6')}
for k,v in seqs.items(): print(k,len(v))

# --- BLOSUM62 NW (vectorised) ---
B="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
ls=B.strip().split('\n');hd=ls[0].split();M62={}
for l in ls[1:]:
    p=l.split()
    for b,v in zip(hd,p[1:]): M62[(p[0],b)]=int(v)
idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(hd)};SM=np.full((21,21),-2.0)
for (a,b),v in M62.items(): SM[idx[a],idx[b]]=v
def enc(s): return np.array([idx.get(c,20) for c in s])
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    e1,e2=enc(s1),enc(s2);n,m=len(s1),len(s2);NEG=-1e9
    Mm=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    Mm[0,0]=0;Ix[1:,0]=go+ge*np.arange(n);pX[1:,0]=1;Iy[0,1:]=go+ge*np.arange(m);pY[0,1:]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        srow=SM[e1[i-1],e2];Mp=Mm[i-1];Xp=Ix[i-1];Yp=Iy[i-1]
        A1=np.vstack([Mp[:-1],Xp[:-1],Yp[:-1]]);Mm[i,1:]=A1.max(0)+srow;pM[i,1:]=A1.argmax(0)
        A2=np.vstack([Mp[1:]+go,Xp[1:]+ge,Yp[1:]+go]);Ix[i,1:]=A2.max(0);pX[i,1:]=A2.argmax(0)
        Mi=Mm[i];Xi=Ix[i];Yi=Iy[i];Pi=pY[i]
        for jj in range(1,m+1):
            a=Mi[jj-1]+go;b=Xi[jj-1]+go;c=Yi[jj-1]+ge
            if a>=b and a>=c: Yi[jj]=a;Pi[jj]=0
            elif b>=c: Yi[jj]=b;Pi[jj]=1
            else: Yi[jj]=c;Pi[jj]=2
    i,jj=n,m;stt=int(np.argmax((Mm[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m])));pr=[]
    while i>0 and jj>0:
        if stt==0: pr.append((i-1,jj-1));stt=pM[i,jj];i-=1;jj-=1
        elif stt==1: stt=pX[i,jj];i-=1
        else: stt=pY[i,jj];jj-=1
    return pr[::-1]

mo=seqs['mouse Accsl Q3UX83']
# mouse positions of interest (1-based), from the structural mapping already done
POS={'Gly263 PLP loop':263,'Tyr289 PLP ring':289,'Asn352 PLP':352,'Asp380 pyridine N1':380,
     'Tyr383 PLP':383,'Ser416 PLP':416,'Lys417 Schiff base':417,'Arg425 phosphate':425,
     'Arg551 substrate COO-':551,'Glu199 (apple E47)':199,'Ser171 (apple Y19)':171,
     'Phe268 (apple N124)':268,'Ile348 (apple T198)':348,'Gly414 (apple S270)':414,
     'Ser227 (apple Q83)':227}
rows=[]
for name,other in [(k,v) for k,v in seqs.items() if not k.startswith('mouse')]:
    pr=nw(mo,other); m2o={a:b for a,b in pr}
    ident=sum(1 for a,b in pr if mo[a]==other[b]); pid=100*ident/min(len(mo),len(other))
    r={'protein':name,'len':len(other),'%id to mouse':round(pid,1)}
    for lab,p in POS.items():
        j=m2o.get(p-1)
        r[lab]=f'{other[j]}{j+1}' if j is not None else 'gap'
    rows.append(r)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option('display.width',400); pd.set_option('display.max_columns',40)
print('\nmouse residue -> equivalent in each homolog (global NW, BLOSUM62, gap -11/-1)')
print('mouse itself: '+', '.join(f'{mo[p-1]}{p}' for p in POS.values()))
print(df.T.to_string())
df.to_csv('accsl_residue_comparison.csv',index=False)

# --- figure: conservation status of each position across the four proteins ---
labels=list(POS)
mouse_res=[f'{mo[p-1]}{p}' for p in POS.values()]
mat=np.zeros((3,len(labels)))
txt=[]
for i,r in enumerate(rows):
    tr=[]
    for j,lab in enumerate(labels):
        v=r[lab]; same = (v!='gap' and v[0]==mouse_res[j][0])
        mat[i,j]= 1 if same else 0
        tr.append(v)
    txt.append(tr)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,3.6))
ax.imshow(mat,cmap='RdYlGn',vmin=0,vmax=1,aspect='auto')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(labels)));ax.set_xticklabels([f'{labels[j]}\n{mouse_res[j]}' for j in range(len(labels))],rotation=55,ha='right',fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_yticks(range(3));ax.set_yticklabels([r['protein'] for r in rows],fontsize=8)
for i in range(3):
    for j in range(len(labels)): ax.text(j,i,txt[i][j],ha='center',va='center',fontsize=7)
ax.set_title('Residues equivalent to the mouse Accsl active site (green = same as mouse)',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
